notes: Generator is a deterministic STUB imitating LLM redundancy; no real model was used.
Redundancy structure (many typical values, few boundary tests) is my own design choice and drives the outcome; real suites may differ greatly.
Single seed, 4 tiny functions, 15 mutants incl. 1 deliberate equivalent mutant: percentages are coarse and not statistically meaningful.
Mutation score here = killed / all mutants, so equivalent/unkilled mutants cap it.
Greedy set cover is a heuristic; it is not guaranteed to be minimal.
mutation_greedy also adds tests to keep full line/branch coverage, so it is not a pure mutation-only reduction.
